'''Tekonite''' was a material used to construct the nosecone of the [[Spiral-class Assault Ship|''Spiral''-class Assault Ship]]. When the ship was used to breach a target, the tekonite nosecone vaporised, asorbing ninety-two percent of the kinetic impact.
